text:
Maya: Quick q — can the saved view preview show an inline per-route cost estimate? e.g. when you hover a saved query in the console, show tokens + $ estimate. Thinking this helps routing/pinning decisions.
Tom: +1 would help. We need telemetry to compute median seq lengths per route though. @Elena do we have that?
Elena: We emit token_count metrics per request, but only at sampling rate right now (1%). We can upsample for savedview previews for active routes.
Ash: Upsampling costs $$; but we can compute an estimate from historics: median_token * avg_model_cost_per_token. Not perfect but cheap.
Priya: Design idea: show 2-line preview: "est cost / run" and "est cost / 1k runs", with a tiny sparkline for variance and a tooltip for assumptions.
Sam: API-wise we could add fields to the saved_view_preview endpoint: cost_estimate, token_stats. E.g.
```json
{"token_stats": {"p50": 120, "p95": 420}, "cost_estimate":{"per_call": 0.00024, "per_1k": 0.24}}
```
Maya: Nice. How do we handle routes with multiple models (fallbacks)? Show weighted blend?
Elena: We already log model_id; we can estimate blended cost by routing policy weight if stored. If not, default to last-known primary model and surface a "multi-model routing" badge.
Ash: Routing policies can be dynamic (canaries). Maybe show "current" vs "historical" estimates and a small age indicator.
Priya: UX suggestion: little flag "uses multi-model routing" with a "show breakdown" expander that lists model / pct / cost.
Tom: Backend note: need to respect quotas + privacy — estimates must be tenant-aggregated and not expose per-customer outliers. Also cache aggressively.
Maya: Agree. Also avoid heavy UI latency; preview should be computed asynchronously and cached (ttl 1h). If stale, show "last computed Xm ago".
Sam: I'll prototype API: `/v1/saved_views/:id/preview_with_cost?cached=true` returns cached object or kicks a background job and returns last cached plus a "stale" flag.
dev-bot: deploy 1746664360: preview-cost-feature -> staging succeeded :rocket:
Priya: I'll mock visuals and share the Figma link shortly. Will include the expander with table and sparkline.
Maya: Can we run a small experiment: show per-call cost preview for 10% of heavy routes and track click-through + pin/change behavior?
Elena: Yep. We can emit `saved_view_cost_preview_shown` and `saved_view_cost_preview_clicked` events, sampled at 10% by default.
Ash: Ops note: add a rate limit on preview recompute per route to avoid thundering herd when many users open console.
Maya: Great — I'll write an RFC with scope: UI tiny badge + per-call & per-1k estimate, cached backend API, opt-in experiment, telemetry events, and privacy constraints. :+1:
